none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Wasserstein convex optimization: V is convex with L-Lipschitz gradient; H and its feasible domain Q are convex along generalized geodesics. A feasible global minimizer exists.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/WassersteinSmoothComposite.lean: Admissible.convex, smooth, generalizedConvex, minimizerFeasible, minimal; GeneralizedGeodesicConvex.

problem_class.label: composite
problem_class.details: Minimize F(μ)=∫V dμ+H(μ) over μ∈Q, with smooth potential energy and a potentially nonsmooth proximal term.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: For h>0, return an exact minimizer over Q of H(u)+W₂²(b,u)/(2h), as an entire distribution.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Exact distribution-valued forward oracle returns (Id−h∇V)#μ; an exact optimal-transport-map oracle is available from feasible μ to any ν. These are whole-distribution operations, rather than pointwise gradient or sampling calls. All three query types share one fixed total call budget. Replies satisfy their specifications for every history and seed; no oracle-error model is imposed.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/WassersteinSmoothComposite.lean: Query, CorrectReply, Admissible.replies, spec; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace, Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: non_euclidean_geometry
distinctive_assumptions.details: Optimization takes place in P₂(ℝᵈ) with quadratic Wasserstein distance. Every feasible measure is absolutely continuous. Generalized-geodesic convexity is required for every base distribution, with optimal joint plans and feasible interpolants.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The underlying particle space is ℝᵈ for public d∈ℕ; the optimization variable is a probability distribution.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Public information consists of d, L>0, R≥0, ε>0, and a feasible initial distribution with W₂²(initial,minimizer)≤R². Q, H, V, its gradient, and the minimizer belong to the hidden instance. No lower semicontinuity or closedness assumption is stated; exact proximal solutions are supplied by the admissible oracle.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/WassersteinSmoothComposite.lean: Public, Params, Instance, Admissible.initialFeasible, initialDistance, replies; spec.valid.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The output must belong to Q and satisfy F(output)−F(minimizer)≤ε.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: Feasibility and the objective-gap bound hold almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: Established Wasserstein composite convex optimization with a smooth potential, generalized-geodesically convex regularization, and idealized exact forward, proximal, and optimal-transport operations.
